item.title: Local wrestlers poised to compete for state titles
item.description: Vacaville High School will be well represented, sending six boys and two girls. The boys consist of Eli Mayer (108), Ethan Busby (122), Daniel Maranan (132), Jack Giangrasso (140), Brady Wight (190) and Ezra Cremo (HWT), while the girls include Kaelena Ahrens (122) and Jenna Patzer (190).
